title: Crypto Trading Signals - August 24, 2026
top_story_headline: Keystone warns that self-custody security can fail through three single points: the seed, hardware vendor and storage location, making multisig and redundancy essential
top_story_comment: 683,130,969.66 ZIL was stolen across 66 transactions after the Zilliqa Ledger app zeroed 64 bits of nonce entropy, letting four public signatures reconstruct a private key in seconds, according to [Zilliqa’s August 20 post-mortem](https://www.zilliqa.com/ledger-incident/post-mortem/). A 2-of-3 using that same app for every signer reproduces the defect across all three keys once each signer publishes four affected signatures.
